_help: Valor (scripts/Valor.cs). Earned only in Wave Survival, when a run first clears a milestone wave; spent with Sera, Valor Quartermaster, in Oakhaven. Wave Survival foes drop no items, gold or materials.
_everyHelp: after the last milestone: every 'every' waves gives 'valor'

gear._help: a chosen slot, rolled at your level + levelBonus with at least this rarity (0 common .. 4 legendary)

gacha._help: one pull = one random item at your level + levelBonus; rarity by weight. pity: a pull after this many without an epic or better gives at least epic.
